description: Screen a crypto wallet address for AML/KYT risk. Returns an AML score (0-100), risk_level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), what the address is (axes: business, legal_status, asset_control, ...), sanctioned exposure, source-of-funds and the incidents (hacks, scams, reports) the address appears in, with its role in each. Chains: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc, tron, solana (on solana the score uses the address's own evidence only). aml_score null means not assessed, never 0 or clean. Anything under community_claims is one victim's unconfirmed report: quote it as a report, never as who the address is. An incident marked 'community report, not confirmed' accuses nobody; 'victim, not accused' is the opposite of an accusation. report_url is the victim-report form: offer it only if the user lost funds. Read-only: it only looks the address up, it never changes anything.

address.description: The wallet address to screen. Solana addresses are case-sensitive.

chain.description: Blockchain: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc, tron or solana.
